_comment: Frozen reference for a verified build, recorded 2026-09-01.
No cohort data is stored - only counts, hashes and fitted statistics.
population_hash is asserted (it covers the exact sample set every score is
relative to); expr_checksum is not, because it moves whenever the source
re-deposits the data, which is a data change rather than a regression.
111 samples with 19 events (17.1%). An event rate near 100% here
would mean censored patients are being dropped rather than censored -
see the censored_time_column note in the spec.
